changeSet.comment: Assign the default shift (Morning Shift) to the HQ admin user if the mapping doesn't already exist. The shift is found by its English translation name, similar to how roles are found by name.
changeSet.sql: -- Insert user-shift mapping for HQ admin user if it doesn't exist -- Find shift by its English translation name (like role lookup by name) INSERT INTO user_shift_mapping (user_id, shift_id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com'), (SELECT shift_id FROM shift_translation WHERE name = 'Morning Shift' AND language_code = 'en' LIMIT 1) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_shift_mapping WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'shailesh.parkhi@joshsoftware.com') );
